history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: 'Gayatri Mandir, Patna' is a generic name — Patna has several Gayatri mandirs (Kankarbagh, Ashok Nagar Shaktipeeth, Rupaspur/Rukanpura, and the Mastichak Shakti Peeth 40 km away). This entry documents the most prominent city shrine, the Gayatri Mandir at Kankarbagh (CC-1, Housing Board Colony, East Indira Nagar; 4.6 rating from 1,248 reviews), noted for Sunday programs and seminars, popular with students, in a peaceful environment. Founding date, managing trust and Gayatri Parivar affiliation are UNVERIFIED. Opening hours conflict across listings, so the CSV identity remains ambiguous; coordinates are an approximate Kankarbagh-area point (verify).

name: Gayatri Mandir, Patna
town_description: Patna is the capital of Bihar and one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities (ancient Pataliputra), set on the southern bank of the Ganga. It is the main rail, road and air gateway of the state and a major pilgrimage transit point for eastern India.

travel.airport: Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, Patna (~10 km; verify)
travel.railway: Rajendra Nagar railway station (~0.61 km per place listing; verify)
travel.road: In Kankarbagh, Patna; reachable by auto-rickshaw and city bus
